The geothermal boiler is the most direct idea of all: burn magma as fuel. A hot bronze unit turns §6375 water/s§r into §660,000 L/s§r; steel takes §6937 water/s§r yet yields only §6149,920 L/s§r — integer division, not a clean 150,000.

The magma side has its own meter: §6333 mB/s§r on a cold machine, §6200§r on hot steel, §6250 mB/s§r once the overheat chip is in.

Byproducts roll on a probability table from §120% obsidian§r down to §10.35% gold§r — lucky rolls are pure profit.
